title: Wendell and the Postcards
author: Odile Zhou
blurb: Oscar Eastwick, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
